title: Final Evolution

encoding.format: MP3 (MPEG-1 Layer III), LAME VBR via libsndfile; preview CBR stereo

notes: Hook = robo_lead (square, short glide): octave yelp -> syncopated 11th, sequenced a minor third up. Freezes: brass hits on 25.1, 27.1, 49.1, 50.1.
